evidence.document: CBI MMBT7002K outline and illustrative Diotec family marking

marking.appearance_status: K72 is an illustrative Diotec family marking; the CBI datasheet does not establish the actual CBI marking. Typeface, placement and production details are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: KiCad SOT-23 2.5 x 3.0 x 1.2 mm model is scaled vertically to 1.1 mm and approximates the CBI outline. The K72 marking comes from a different manufacturer and is illustrative. Finish and fine details are approximate; not a manufacturing model or footprint.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
